text:
olivia: Quick thread to capture a slightly different angle on rollout metadata: specifically deprecation tethering and resolver patterns. I'm worried about long-lived pins becoming accidental debt. Idea: attach a small "tether" token to anchors that encodes billing reason + auto-expiry policy.

sam: tether token sounds useful. Are you proposing it be part of the anchor doc or baked into the on-path token? my vote: off-path anchor doc only, runtime reads a 1-byte flag "tethered" and optionally a short tether-id. keeps headers tiny.

maria: observability: if tether is about billing or compliance, we must emit a discrete audit event whenever tethered anchors are created/renewed + include tether_id and who approved. add this to the control-plane audit log.

dinesh: runtime constraints: we only accept a boolean tether flag on-path. full tether details live in control-plane. runtime will refuse to honor anchors that are tethered if the tenant's billing status is delinquent; check should be cheap (cache tenant billing-ok bit, TTL 5m).

anjali: SDK UX: expose `getTetherInfo(tenant)` and a callback `onTetherStateChange(tenant, state)`. apps can display messages like "your tenant is pinned for billing reasons". Also let SDK opt-out for internal infra via `ignore_tethers` flag.

kevin: ops/playbook: tethered anchors must require two approvals in UI (SRE + finance) and create a ticket in billing queue. also auto-expire in 30 days unless renewed. include `renew_count` limit.

olivia: sample anchor (off-path) idea (human readable): ``{ anchor_id: "anch-3133-01", tenant: "beta-co", pinned_ref: "v4.0", expires_at: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z", tethered: true, tether_id: "t-9812", tether_reason: "billing_hold", renew_count: 0 }``. runtime only sees anchor_id + tethered boolean.

sam: about resolver patterns: propose resolver layers - 1) tenant-anchor lookup (fast cache), 2) rollout-ref lookup, 3) global default. each layer returns compact runtime view: `ref`, `fallbacks[]`, `safety_policy_token`. runtime selects best immediate fallback without parsing full docs.

maria: telemetry: emit which resolver layer matched via span attribute `pin_resolution_layer`. also emit `tether_status` and `tether_id` (if present) in audit logs only, not in high-cardinality traces.

dinesh: cache design: maintain two caches: hot LRU for resolved refs keyed by token (short TTL), and a pinned set keyed by tenant for anchors (longer TTL until expiry). eviction should respect memory cap and pin-count. miss path: return configured default fallback list synchronously.

kevin: monitoring: create an "anchor-entropy" metric: ratio of anchors older than 30 days / total anchors. threshold triggers a cleanup cadence. Also alert if tethered-anchors > X because that indicates a billing policy trend.

anjali: QA: add a synthetic that simulates billing hold -> tether created -> observe SDK callback and runtime refusing new model features. Validate automated renewal circuit and UI approval flow.

olivia: protocol nuance: when renewing a tethered anchor we should rotate anchor_id to force SDKs to refresh caches (avoid stale local pin). control-plane must create new anchor_id on renew.

sam: implementation: anchor_id rotation is fine. also make sure token->ref mapping is monotonic so caches can detect a change quickly (a small version bump byte in token).

maria: privacy note: tether_reason can contain PII only if encrypted in storage. default to enumerated values (billing_hold, compliance_hold, legal_hold). avoid freeform text.

dinesh: runtime probe enhancement: extend `/v1/pin-info?tenant=...` to return `tethered: true|false` and `effective_fallbacks[]` but do not return tether_reason unless caller has audit scope. keep the probe rate-limited.

ops-bot: :bell: Anchor rotation policy applied to tenant beta-co. new anchor anch-3133-02 created with tether_id t-9812 (expires 2026-09-01).

kevin: follow-ups: I'll add the anchor-entropy dashboard and tethered-anchor alert. ops will require the two-approval flow in the UI.

olivia: next steps: (1) sam to draft resolver layering and token version nibble, (2) dinesh to spec cache + probe changes, (3) maria to add audit + telemetry rules (including limiting tether_reason exposure), (4) kevin to add ops dashboards and UI approval workflow. i'll author the anchor schema PR with tether fields.

sam: will prototype the token nibble today.

maria: will draft telemetry constraints and secure fields.

dinesh: will sketch cache eviction heuristics and probe auth.

anjali: will write SDK hooks for tether events and opt-out flag.

olivia: thanks all, keeping this short since details will land in the PR :thumbsup:
